review.instruction: Confirm the approval names this exact boundary, target ref and optional tag, the routed checkout is verified, and the published commit is exactly the quality-verified commit.
Confirm the exact changed-file set is owned by the approved boundary, nothing dirty lies outside it, and session evidence required by the delivery chain is present at the same head.
Verify installed hooks ran without bypass. Any integration merge uses a merge commit, resolves only rule-covered owned hunks, and reruns the named gates after conflict resolution.

Confirm the target ref was created as approved or advanced fast-forward only, no force or rebase occurred, and fetch/read-back equals the published commit. A changed or uncertain remote is observed before any retry.
When requested, confirm exactly one authorized annotated tag points to the published head; otherwise confirm no tag was created.

failurePolicy: Record the exact authority, boundary, hook, ancestry or remote defect and reassess after targeted repair. Never retry an uncertain push before fetching the remote, and never use force, rebase or hook bypass.
